name: 3 Amigos Chinese Cruise
description:
Welcome aboard to 3 AMIGOS CHINESE CRUISE, where every dish is a flavorful journey! We serve authentic Indo-Chinese cuisine with bold spices, sizzling aromas and irresistible street-style flair. From crispy starters to saucy gravies and fragrant rice & noodles, every bite is crafted fresh by expert chefs using premium ingredients.
Our specialties include Kung Pao Chicken, Masala Lollypop, Pan-Fried Chow Mein, Schezwan Rice, and Crunchy Paneer Crispy - perfect for spice lovers and food explorers! Whether you're dining with friends, family, or grabbing a quick bite, we promise delicious taste, generous portions, and unbeatable value.
Step in, relax and enjoy the vibrant ambience.
🌶️ You can experience Veg and Non-Veg at 3ACC!

Great taste, quality, and value—all in one place.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in bylanes of IC Colony, this small cozy place serves some delicious food.

Here is what we tried:
• Steamed wantons:  Beautiful made and perfectly flavoured. These wantons are an absolute must try.

•Soy wine chili chicken: A unique dish but it felt like it required a little more of flavour balance especially considering it had soy and wine.

• Prawn Red Pepper: Another must try dish. The pepper base with the soft juicy prawn is a match made in heaven.

• Prawn Orange: This one was definitely unique combo of a sweet orangy base with crisp prawns. If only the base was slightly thicker, the crispness of the prawns would have been maintained and would have taken the dish to the next level.

All in all a great place to have some flavourful meals

featured_reviews.review_text:

​The Highlights:
​The Chinese Food: Truly top-notch! While I’ve noticed the North Indian dishes have become a bit more "average" lately, the Chinese menu remains consistently excellent.
​Quality & Safety: One of the main reasons I keep coming back is the food quality. In four years, I have never had any digestive issues, which speaks volumes about their hygiene and ingredients.
​Service & Atmosphere: The ambiance is lovely, and the staff's hospitality is always warm and welcoming. Their home delivery service is also very reliable and prompt.
​My Personal Recommendations:
If you are visiting or ordering in, you have to try these:
​Kung Pao Chicken
​Teriyaki Chicken
​Chinese Village Special Rice
​Hakka Noodles
​Burnt Garlic Rice
​Chilli Garlic Noodles
​I highly recommend this place if you are craving authentic, high-quality Chinese food!

featured_reviews.name: Abhilasha Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have visited this place multiple times, when it comes to chinese food this is best option nearby, Well we have decided to celebrate my In-laws wedding anniversary over there however we had very disappointing experience. We went to FOC expecting to try several dishes listed on the menu, but most of them were not available. Nearly every time we ordered something, the staff said it was “not available today,” which made the menu feel pointless. Not even fried noodles which is basis in any Chinese restaurant was not available. Their special dishes was not available

After going through multiple options, we were left with only a few basic choices. It was frustrating because we specifically came to try certain dishes, but the restaurant couldn’t provide them. If a restaurant lists items on the menu, they should actually have them available.

Overall, poor planning and a very unsatisfying experience. I wouldn’t recommend coming here unless you’re okay with most of the menu being unavailable. Pathetic service we have experience on our special day. If they don't know how to handle Online order along with restaurant they should not run restaurant, either run dining or cloud kitchen. Not going to visit nor recommending this place any more.

One of my new favourite!
*Food-Tasty chinese food, has good quality and quantity.
Must try Hong Kong rice, pot rice, tripe Schezwan rice and chopper rice.
I loved their honey chilli potatoes and Thai green curry.
They do not add too much food colour and that's the plus, The flavour of every dish is different.
They serve free kimchi Salad.

The take away packs are of 1000ml containers (for rice/noodles) which Is enough to serve 2-3 people.

*Ambience and price - ambience is dim and has wall paited with Chinese symbols, they have nice hand painted lamps, there is Seating area down as well as on 1st floor.

featured_reviews.name: NomNom Mumbaikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to Chinese or pan Asian food I can only think of Flavours of China. It has been a saviour from quite sometime now. It truly satisfy my craving for Chinese also my hunger. I don’t even remember the count for how many times I have ordered from this place now.

The menu here is vast and has got lots of variety with them. Starting from soups till dessert they have got it all whether it is Thai curry, lollipop, chopper rice, pot rice or fried wanton, noodles, their signature dish FOC chicken I love them all. Their signature dish is my most favourite one. With every bite you know the chicken, the vegetable or the ingredients whatever they use is fresh. Also they pack the food nicely and deliver it safely to us.

Not only that they also think about their customers by providing free gift of certain percent discount on our next order. One of the best pas Asian restaurant in the neighbourhood of Borivali. Highly recommend food from here.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A really decent place for delicious indo-chinese cuisine! They have great quantity & quality of food! A must-try. Ordered spring rolls and a Veg Steak Sizzler, it was sufficient for 3-4 people. Glad to have found this place, pretty underrated + affordable + provides great service. There's some waiting time during weekends, but it's worth it because the food is amazing :)

They don't serve sizzlers on Sundays, so if you're going to try that, go on weekdays/Saturday instead!

Noodles -
They do have an amazing variety of noodles, btw. Tried their veg fried rice, veg hakka noodles and Phad Thai Phak Noodles. The Thai noodles tasted great, had different veggies and an exotic flavor...yummm!

Brownie -
I'm not much of a dessert person, but once I tried their sizzling walnut chocolate brownie, I changed my mind. Loved how the roasted walnut pieces blended in with the scoop of vanilla ice cream🤍

review_photos.caption: This is a bowl of half-eaten Phad Thai Phak Noodles, so the quantity is more than this. Basically, full to the brim.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited for dinner with friends and, though we had to wait over half an hour, we were looking forward to a good time together. Upon entering, we were informed that our seating would be separate, which was disappointing as we wanted to enjoy the evening as a group of 8. After some discussion with the staff, they managed to arrange seating for us together, which we appreciated. The food, however, made up for any earlier issues. We started with Chinese bhel, which had a delightful crunch and unique flavors. The Sanjhi special sizzler was a highlight, full of vibrant taste and satisfying portions. Fried rice was well-prepared, and we ended with a warm brownie that hit the spot. The food was delicious, and we all left feeling happy and satisfied, ultimately making the evening a success despite the initial hiccup. Would recommend for the food, but it might help to check on seating arrangements ahead of time!

featured_reviews.name: Srishti Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located close to Borivali station, this place has been serving mouthwatering desi chinese for years now. The ambience and decor is average at best, but that is not the thing regular patrons return here for. Their food sells for itself and it is damn yummy.
Quantity is really good here, usually one dish being enough for two people easily. To add to that, their food is at a very reasonable price. Service is prompt and even though the staff are not highly trained, they do get the job done. We had the following to eat :
Chicken Sweet Corn Soup - Large pieces of perfectly cooked chicken in a thick soup consisting of egg and sweet corn, it felt really good in this cold weather.
Triple Chicken Rice - Yummy fried rice served along with spicy schezwan gravy, it was a perfect match. The gravy was absolutely flavourful and filled with chunks of chicken. It gave the rice some much needed support, as the rice on its own was a bit underwhelming. We would recommend this for the gravy itself..😋

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Mathkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let’s talk about the food first. Overall, the experience was okayish. The menu has a wide variety of options, which is definitely a plus, but unfortunately the taste didn’t quite live up to expectations.
We started with the Manchow Soup, and honestly, this was the highlight of the meal. The flavour was good, comforting, and well-balanced. The portion size was decent for the price, making it a value-for-money starter.
Next, we tried the Honey Coriander Chicken. The dish was average—for ₹300, we received six pieces of chicken, which felt a little less. It leaned more towards the sweet side, though the server had already informed us that it would be sweet with a hint of spice, so there were no surprises there.
After that came the Chicken Shanghai Rice. While the portion size was generous, the dish itself was quite disappointing. The chicken quantity was minimal, with more egg and paneer dominating the rice. The rice was dry and lacked flavour, which really took away from the overall experience.
On a positive note, the ambience of the restaurant was really nice. There’s also an open seating area, which adds to the vibe and makes it a pleasant place to sit and relax. The staff was courteous and helpful, patiently explaining the dishes when needed.
To sum it up, the restaurant scores well on ambience and service, but the food quality needs improvement. Overall, I’d rate this place 2 out of 5.

featured_reviews.name: Dipesh Malvade
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re a fan of Indo-Chinese street food, Om Uncle’s Chinese Corner in Marol is a spot you can’t miss! 🏮✨ I finally visited this famous joint and tried their Triple Fried Rice, and here’s my detailed experience.

Food 🍽️:

The Triple Fried Rice was absolutely packed with flavors! 😋 A perfect mix of fried rice, noodles, and crispy noodles on top, all tossed in a spicy, tangy sauce. The balance of textures—soft rice, chewy noodles, and crispy toppings—made every bite exciting. The quantity was generous, making it a great option for sharing. They don’t hold back on flavors, so expect a bold, spicy, and satisfying experience! 🌶️🔥

Ambience & Crowd 🏠:

The place has a classic street-food vibe—nothing too fancy but clean and functional. The seating is minimal, so be ready to wait, especially during peak hours. It was super crowded, which speaks volumes about its popularity! 🏃‍♂️💨 If you’re someone who enjoys the hustle and bustle of a busy food spot, you’ll love the energy here!

Service ⏳:

Despite the crowd, service was quick and efficient. The staff is friendly, and they make sure orders are served fresh and hot. Since it's a small setup, don’t expect fine-dining comfort, but for a street-food joint, it’s well-managed.

Price 💰:

Very affordable for the portion size and taste. You get value for money, making it a great spot for a budget-friendly, tasty meal.

Verdict ⭐:

✅ Must-try for Indo-Chinese lovers
✅ Great flavors & quantity
✅ Crowded but worth it
⚠️ Limited seating & wait time

If you’re in Marol and craving some spicy, flavorful Chinese street food, this place should be on your list! Would definitely visit again. 🥢🔥
